reviews.title: Nice monitor, good specs and large screen
reviews.comment: So far, we really like this monitor and its specs. It's quite large so if you need two windows up at the same time, you have plenty of real estate. Built in speakers are nicer than my laptop also.

reviews.title: Value monitor
reviews.comment: Makes a weird high pitch noise whenever its turned on. It increases in pitch until I can't hear it anymore. Otherwise, it's as good as I could expect for the price. Refresh rate, resolution, brightness all seem good. Color accuracy is average. If you're doing photo editing professionally, I'd recommend looking elsewhere. For gaming, office work, casual use, its a great value.
reviews.author: Jofre A. Steele
